root.label: Australian Commonwealth cybersecurity posture report released

events.label: Australian Commonwealth cybersecurity posture report released

slots.name: affected agencies
slots.sentence: In the Australian government’s commonwealth cybersecurity posture in 2025 report released in February this year, 59% of federal agencies and departments reported their ability to implement the “essential eight” measures to reduce cyber risk was being affected by use of legacy technologies.

slots.name: funding barrier share
slots.sentence: Of those agencies being hindered by legacy tech, 34% blamed insufficient dedicated funding, while 18% said it was due to a lack of a viable replacement.
